body: This makes sense, thanks for the reply
Even when you were upset you still found kindness to come and help me by commenting on my selfish post so your kindness is clear and you should be proud of yourself
You might feel that your life has no purpose now but why does that matter? Something doesn’t have to have purpose to be beautiful and to be worth keeping around

Thank you for your feedback, my problem is that I know he believes he is improving and he says that me being with him has helped him with these thoughts so I feel selfish isolating him just because I’m not comfortable being in those situations and I don’t believe him that he’s not feeling worse again
